note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: A 110K-like reel presents a 'Christmas Elegance ZARA' lookbook — all black (and one burgundy) holiday outfits: a black lace bralette with crystal-embellished wide-leg jeans, a black one-shoulder bow top and blazer, a black sequined halter mini dress with fringe under a black faux-fur coat, high-waisted black trousers with a large satin bow and a feather-trimmed halter top, a sleek black backless halter maxi dress with gold-toe heels and a long velvet coat, a black beaded camisole with satin culottes, a black peplum top with lace trim over burgundy satin pants, and a black velvet strapless midi dress with pink floral embroidery. A 56K-like reel pairs two women in matching floor-length sequin halter gowns — one champagne gold, one silver — with a lace-up corset back, pitched as 'perfect for New Year's'. A 6.2K-like reel shows 'H&M Xmas Looks' — a floor-length gold sequin slip dress with an open back and nude heels, then a champagne satin corset top with white wide-leg Zara trousers, an ornate gold-beaded fringed capelet and a multi-strand pearl choker. A 5K-like reel cycles through '10 plus size christmas party outfits' — a black sequin jumpsuit with a belt, a burgundy satin midi dress, a black sheer lace jumpsuit and a burgundy velvet wrap dress. A 3.3K-like reel offers 'Midsize Christmas Party Inspo!' with five looks — a burgundy sequined lace two-piece set, an olive-green ruched maxi dress, a brown top with a gold sequin mini skirt and knee-high boots, a dark velvet one-shoulder jumpsuit, and a black sequin blazer-and-shorts set. A 1.9K-like reel styles a shiny red sequin mini skirt with an oversized mustard-yellow satin shirt, layered gold necklaces, burgundy heels and a pale yellow handbag.
trends.title: Black sequins rule the party — Zara elegance, gold gowns and H&M sparkle

trends.details: A 12K-like reel gives a 'Christmas House Tour Part 1' — a gold-themed tree with oversized bells, nutcracker ornaments and pearl garlands, a red-themed tree with velvet bows and candy jars, and a 'Polar Express' / 'Home Alone' tree with train tracks, pizza boxes and signs reading 'Believe' and 'Merry Christmas Ya Filthy Animal!', plus a hallway lined with multiple trees. A 12K-like reel builds a storybook Christmas in a rustic living room — lush green garland across a white stone fireplace mantel, red berries, oversized glowing gold globe ornaments on the tree, brass candlesticks, green books topped with a lighted globe, and long red-and-white checkered ribbons. A 6.5K-like reel decorates 'Tree Number Two' as a maximalist twist on a Ralph Lauren-style tree — a bare pre-lit tree bought for $17 at Goodwill, dressed with handmade plaid ornaments, green baubles, repurposed burlap ribbons, vintage toy cars, bells, lanterns and tennis rackets, finished with a large multi-ribbon bow. A 5.6K-like reel opens with the ironic caption 'We keep our Christmas decor super simple!' while dragging a huge tree box upstairs — then a tall pre-lit tree, a ledge of Santa figurines, thick green garland across doorways and the staircase, stockings and miniature village houses on the mantel, dried orange slice garlands and velvet bows. A 3.3K-like reel tours a home where the tree wears colorful pom-poms, dried orange slices and ribbons, paper chain garlands hang from the ceiling, and the narrator repeats 'I love stuff' while the TV plays 'Home Alone'. A 1.1K-like reel posted today makes the case for a 'colorful Christmas' — rainbow paper-chain garlands on the staircase, pom-pom garlands around a mirror, gingerbread-man garlands on the windows, and a tree covered in multicolored baubles and ribbons.
trends.title: Every tree gets a theme — gold bells, storybook mantels and thrifted maximalism

trends.details: A 27K-like reel presents the KIKO Milano Twist 'N Twinkle Collection — Deco Flush Blush in warm pink, a Triple Charm Eyeshadow Palette in silver, lavender and gray, a glittery mauve-pink Twist 'N Sparkle Statement Lipstick, and a Pearly Puff Glow Highlighter for a festive, glowing finish. A 23K-like close-up shows full glam — defined brows, smoky eyeshadow, long lashes and glossy brown-pink lips — while the creator applies a clear glittery SHEGLAM lip gloss. A 5.2K-like tutorial demos an 'easy Santa hat makeup' look, using an eyelash curler as a stencil to draw a Santa hat on the forehead with dark red liquid lipstick, then stippling the fluffy trim and pom-pom with bright pink liquid blush. A 3.7K-like tutorial builds an 'Euphoria x Winter' look — platinum-white hair, dramatic smoky grey-blue eyeshadow, sharp winged liner, heavy false lashes and glitter 'tears' streaming down the cheeks. A 3.2K-like tutorial opens a Holiday Glam series with a 'cranberry champagne blown-out eye' — cranberry and purple tones blended in the crease from the Morphe 35T 'Tis the Season' palette, a shimmery gold inner lid, false lashes and glossy lips. A 3.1K-like tutorial creates 'warm gingerbread cookies lips' — lips dusted with loose powder, outlined in black then brown liner, finished with a glossy nude-pink tint.
trends.title: Glitter, gingerbread lips and snow-halo eyes — holiday glam turns playful
